name: cindr
description: Cindr FinOps and remediation platform monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cindr/cloud-adapters && npm run build --workspace @cindr/db && npm run build --workspace @cindr/slack && npm run build --workspace @cindr/api && npm run build --workspace @cindr/web && npm run build --workspace @cindr/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @cindr/cloud-adapters && npm run build --workspace @cindr/db && npm run build --workspace @cindr/slack && npm run typecheck --workspace @cindr/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @cindr/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @cindr/worker
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @cindr/cloud-adapters && npm run build --workspace @cindr/db && npm run build --workspace @cindr/slack
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test --workspace @cindr/worker && npm test --workspace @cindr/slack && npm test --workspace @cindr/api
